items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That's why it's good to see somebody like Louie Bellson, who likes beautiful arrangements, too. [INTERVIEWEE] Right, right.

ctx.x: Right. Well, that's true, too, that's true. But, see, it's just like anything else. It's just a thing that happened years ago that you have to live down, and you're not going to live it down in two or three days. It's going to take time, a lot of time, for it to live down.
That's why it's good to see somebody like Louie Bellson, who likes beautiful arrangements, too.
